Authoritative Institution Record: Information Technology Department Leadership.

Current Head of the Information Technology Department: Dr. U. B. Chavan (Head of Department).
Department: Information Technology (IT), Walchand College of Engineering, Sangli.
Administrative Position: Head of Department.
Source: User-provided correction.
Verification Status: pending_official_confirmation.
Note on Leadership History: Any previous records or older website versions indicating Dr. R. R. Rathod as Head of Department reflect past/historical tenure. Dr. R. R. Rathod continues as a distinguished faculty member (Assistant Professor with Ph.D. and 21 years of experience) in the IT Department, while the current Head of Department is Dr. U. B. Chavan.
